meta.name: WealthSmith Primitive Typography Tokens
meta.description: Raw typography values for the WealthSmith design system. These tokens define font families, font sizes, weights, line heights, and letter spacing.

manrope.description: Primary WealthSmith font for headings, body text, labels, and general UI copy

spaceGrotesk.description: Secondary WealthSmith font for metrics, numbers, financial data, and chart values

12.description: Small utility text size for non-essential UI labels only

16.description: Default body text and small heading size

18.description: Large body text and medium heading size

20.description: Large heading and secondary metric value size

24.description: Largest heading and primary metric value size

medium.description: Medium text weight for labels, metrics, and chart text

semibold.description: Semibold text weight for medium and small headings

bold.description: Bold text weight for major headings, emphasis, and primary metrics

16.description: Tight line height for very small labels

28.description: Default line height for 18px text and 20px headings

32.description: Default line height for 24px headings and primary metrics

tight.description: Slightly tighter spacing for large headings and metrics if needed
